title: The Last Signal

characters.name: Captain Zara Okafor
characters.description: A seasoned deep-space captain known for calm judgment and dry humor. She carries guilt from a past mission gone wrong.

characters.name: Kai
characters.description: The ship's artificial intelligence, loyal and slightly sardonic. Communicates through holographic displays.

world_notes: Set aboard the research vessel Meridian, drifting through uncharted space near the Veil Nebula. Humanity has FTL travel but no contact with alien life — until now.
